protocol.dataset: Wintermute & Silver 2010 (10.1038/msb.2010.66), 1,035 unordered pairs of 46 Keio auxotrophs
protocol.model: iML1515 (exact acquired file; hash taken from the case inputs); authors modelled iAF1260
protocol.model_role: development transportability baseline, not the authors' model
protocol.glucose_note: normalisation assumption (as in the auxotroph protocols); NOT inferred from 20 g/l
protocol.medium_components_from_input: printed M9 exchanges other than glucose supplied at the ceiling
protocol.trace_metals: taken from inputs.medium.assumed_not_in_paper.trace_exchanges; assumed required, not measured
protocol.oxygen_selection: all three are reported; none is chosen by outcome
protocol.maintenance: model-native R_ATPM lower bound, read from the model, not tuned
protocol.biomass: the model's single active-objective biomass reaction, normalised to 1 gDW
protocol.community: balanced growth, common growth rate mu, equal biomass fractions 0.5/0.5, objective max mu
protocol.monocultures: same pool, ports, supply and removal, fraction 1, identical gene deletion
protocol.pool: each model-native extracellular species (unique SBML species id) is one pool metabolite; every native external exchange of every organism is a port with support 'predicted'
protocol.removal: every pool metabolite may be removed up to the ceiling (waste accumulates in the medium); removal never supplies anything
protocol.internal_bounds: model transport and reaction bounds kept; non-port single-metabolite reactions get no uptake
protocol.gene_deletion: locus tag -> model gene product -> Model.blocked_by_genes (GPR-aware); no guessed genes
protocol.control: same pair and deletions with uptake from the pool forbidden for every metabolite that is not a medium nutrient or one of H2O, H+, CO2, O2 (no cross-organism transfer of other metabolites)
protocol.prediction: positive iff community grows AND both matched monocultures do not grow; one or two viable monocultures are flagged separately and are not positive
protocol.infeasibility: infeasible under fixed maintenance = predicted no growth (primary); strict variant treats it as unknown; solver errors and exhausted budget are unknown
protocol.labels: paper thresholds on mean day-4 fold growth: synergy > 50, no_synergy < 8, intermediate kept separate
protocol.scope: feasibility of mutual growth in static balanced growth only; not fold change or fitness
